settings.single_payload: grayscale image, one value per cell (Z)
settings.pair_payload: viridis-coloured image as HSV value -> theta (Z) and hue -> phi (X)
settings.colour_render: value and hue at full saturation
settings.drr_scope: per field, from that field's input summary statistics
settings.simulation: per-cell, local (per-qubit) calibrated noise; noiseless = shot noise only
